```go
const (
	// timeQuality is the TimeQuality of zero values (ZeroValue): no
	// flags, 10 bits of sub-second accuracy.

	// DefaultTimeQuality is the TimeQuality octet of T when
	// PublisherConfig.TimeQuality is zero: ClockNotSynchronized (0x20,
	// 7-2 TimeQuality / 8-1 8.1.3.7) with 10 bits of sub-second
	// accuracy. The publisher cannot know whether the host clock is
	// synchronised, so it does not claim it.
	DefaultTimeQuality uint8 = 0x2a

	// MaxRefLen and MaxGoIDLen are the maximum gocbRef/datSet and goID
	// lengths (IEC 61850-8-1 18.1.2.5.2: VISIBLE-STRING up to 129 and
	// 65 octets).
	MaxRefLen  = 129
	MaxGoIDLen = 65

	// MaxRetransmission bounds MaxTime: the retransmission interval
	// stays below 60 s (IEC 61850-8-1 18.1.2.5.1 Figure 10 key 4).
	MaxRetransmission = 60 * time.Second

	DefaultMinTime = 10 * time.Millisecond
	DefaultMaxTime = 1000 * time.Millisecond
)
```

Default retransmission parameters (IEC 61850-8-1 Annex C leaves the values to configuration; these match common SCL MinTime/MaxTime defaults).

DecodeData decodes a single BER-encoded MMS Data value using DefaultLimits. Trailing bytes are rejected.

### func Encode

```go
func Encode(f *Frame) ([]byte, error)
```

Encode returns the wire encoding of f. Frames shorter than 60 octets are zero-padded. It fails with ErrLimitExceeded if the Ethernet payload would exceed MaxPayload and with ErrInvalidValue for values that cannot be encoded.

### func EncodeData

```go
func EncodeData(v *mms.Value) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodeData returns the BER encoding of a single MMS Data value as used in GOOSE allData. Floats are sent as FLOAT32 when exactly representable and as FLOAT64 otherwise.

### func EncodeFixedLength

```go
func EncodeFixedLength(f *Frame, types []mms.TypeSpec) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodeFixedLength is [Encode](#func-encode) with the fixed-length goosePdu of [EncodePDUFixedLength](#func-encodepdufixedlength).

### func EncodePDU

```go
func EncodePDU(p *PDU) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodePDU returns the BER encoding of the goosePdu APDU (\[APPLICATION 1]).

The encoder does not enforce the value ranges of IEC 61850-8-1 18.1.2.5.2 (string sizes, stNum and timeAllowedToLive >= 1) so that negative test frames can be built; [NewPublisher](#func-newpublisher) enforces them.

### func EncodePDUFixedLength

```go
func EncodePDUFixedLength(p *PDU, types []mms.TypeSpec) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodePDUFixedLength returns the fixed-length encoding of the goosePdu (IEC 61850-8-1 Annex A.3). types gives the MMS type of each allData member: integer widths come from TypeSpec.Size (8, 16, 32 or 64 bits; unknown widths are sent as 32 bits, or 64 for values outside the 32-bit range), FLOAT64 from FormatWidth 64. Without a type every member is encoded as above with unknown widths. Values that do not fit their fixed size (an OCTET STRING longer than 20 octets, a VISIBLE STRING longer than 35) fail with ErrInvalidValue.

Deviations: FLOAT32 is sent with the 5-octet MMS FloatingPoint encoding (exponent-width octet 8 plus IEEE 754 single) that MMS decoders expect, not the 4 octets of Table A.2; MMSString, GeneralizedTime, BCD and object identifiers, not covered by Table A.2, keep their BER encoding.

### func MatchesType

```go
func MatchesType(v *mms.Value, ts mms.TypeSpec) bool
```

MatchesType reports whether v conforms to the MMS type ts. Sizes are checked for bit strings with a fixed size; integer widths are not enforced, and floats of either width match FLOAT32/FLOAT64.

### func SameShape

```go
func SameShape(a, b *mms.Value) bool
```

SameShape reports whether a and b have the same MMS type and, for structures and arrays, recursively the same element shapes. Values are not compared.

### func ZeroValue

```go

```

ZeroValue returns the zero value of an MMS type that can be encoded in GOOSE.

### type EventKind

```go
type EventKind int
```

EventKind classifies subscriber events.

```go
const (
	// EventMessage is an accepted, valid message. Event.NewState
	// reports whether it starts a new state (stNum changed).
	EventMessage EventKind = iota + 1

	// EventTimeout reports that TimeAllowedToLive elapsed without a
	// message.
	EventTimeout

	// EventStNumGap reports that one or more state changes were missed
	// (stNum advanced by more than one). The message itself is also
	// delivered as EventMessage.
	EventStNumGap

	// EventSqNumGap reports missed retransmissions within a state (or a
	// new state that did not start at sqNum 0). The message is also
	// delivered.
	EventSqNumGap

	// EventDuplicate reports a repeated stNum/sqNum pair. The message
	// is not delivered.
	EventDuplicate

	// EventOutOfOrder reports a message older than the last accepted
	// one. The message is not delivered.
	EventOutOfOrder

	// EventRestart reports that the publisher restarted: stNum went
	// back to 0 or 1, or stNum/sqNum did not advance but T is newer than
	// that of the last accepted state. The message is also delivered.
	EventRestart

	// EventInvalid reports a message that failed validation; Event.Err
	// is a [*ValidationError]. The message is not delivered.
	EventInvalid

	// EventSupervision reports a change of Event.State.Status.
	EventSupervision
)
```

### type Frame

```go
type Frame struct {
	// Dst and Src are the Ethernet destination and source addresses.
	Dst, Src MAC

	// decoders leave it zero.

}
```

### type Metrics

```go
type Metrics interface {
	// FrameSent is called after a frame has been handed to the
	// transport. retransmission is false for the first frame of a new
	// state (sqNum 0).
	FrameSent(gocbRef string, retransmission bool)

	// SendError is called when the transport rejected a frame.
	SendError(gocbRef string, err error)

	// FrameReceived is called for every decoded frame that matched at
	// least one subscription.
	FrameReceived(gocbRef string)

	// FrameDropped is called for a received frame that was discarded
	// before reaching a subscription. reason is one of "decode",
	// "simulation", "filtered".
	FrameDropped(reason string)

	// Event is called for every subscriber event, including events
	// dropped because the event queue was full (dropped == true).
	Event(gocbRef string, kind EventKind, dropped bool)
}
```

Metrics receives counters from publishers and subscribers. All methods must be safe for concurrent use and should return quickly; they are called on the send and receive paths. Embed [NopMetrics](#type-nopmetrics) to implement only the hooks you need.

### type PDU

```go
type PDU struct {
	// GocbRef is the GoCB reference, e.g. "IED1LD0/LLN0$GO$gcb1".
	GocbRef string

	// TimeAllowedToLive is the time in milliseconds the subscriber
	// shall wait for the next message before declaring the stream
	// lost.
	TimeAllowedToLive uint32

	// DatSet is the dataset reference, e.g. "IED1LD0/LLN0$ds1".
	DatSet string

	// GoID is the GOOSE identifier (optional on the wire; omitted when
	// empty).
	GoID string

	// T is the time of the last state change (stNum increment).
	T time.Time

	// TimeQuality is the TimeQuality octet of T.
	TimeQuality uint8

	// StNum is the state number, incremented on every data change.
	StNum uint32

	// SqNum is the sequence number, incremented on every retransmission
	// and reset to 0 on a state change.
	SqNum uint32

	// Test is the goosePdu [7] BOOLEAN ("test" in Ed1, "simulation" in
	// Ed2). Encoded always.
	Test bool

	// ConfRev is the configuration revision of the dataset.
	ConfRev uint32

	// NdsCom ("needs commissioning") is encoded always.
	NdsCom bool

	// NumDatSetEntries is the number of top-level allData entries. On
	// encode, zero means len(AllData); a non-zero value is sent
	// verbatim (useful for negative tests).
	NumDatSetEntries uint32

	// AllData holds the dataset member values.
	AllData []*mms.Value

	// Security is the raw content of the optional [12] security field.
	// It is carried but not interpreted.
	Security []byte
}
```

PDU is the IECGoosePdu (IEC 61850-8-1 Annex A).

### type Publisher

```go
type Publisher struct {

	// TimeQuality of tChange

	// a first state has been sent

	// non-nil for FixedOffs

}
```

Publisher sends one GOOSE control block's messages: a new state (stNum+1, sqNum 0) on every [Publisher.Publish](#func-publisher-publish) followed by retransmissions at MinTime, 2\*MinTime, 4\*MinTime ... up to the MaxTime heartbeat (IEC 61850-8-1 Annex C).

A Publisher is safe for concurrent use. Publish sends synchronously for minimum latency; [Publisher.Run](#func-publisher-run) drives retransmissions.

#### func NewPublisher

```go
func NewPublisher(t Transport, cfg PublisherConfig) (*Publisher, error)
```

NewPublisher validates cfg and returns a publisher bound to t. It sends nothing until [Publisher.Run](#func-publisher-run) or [Publisher.Publish](#func-publisher-publish) is called.

#### func (Publisher) Close

```go
func (p *Publisher) Close() error
```

Close stops the publisher. Run returns and further calls fail with ErrClosed. The transport is not closed.

#### func (Publisher) Config

```go
func (p *Publisher) Config() PublisherConfig
```

Config returns the effective configuration (defaults applied).

#### func (Publisher) Publish

```go
func (p *Publisher) Publish(values []*mms.Value) error
```

Publish starts a new state with the given dataset values: stNum is incremented (rolling over to 1), sqNum reset to 0, T set to now, and the message sent immediately. The retransmission curve restarts.

The number of values and their types must match the previous state (or PublisherConfig.Values); otherwise Publish fails with ErrInvalidValue and nothing is sent. The values are deep-copied.

#### func (Publisher) Run

```go
func (p *Publisher) Run(ctx context.Context) error
```

Run drives retransmissions until ctx is done or the publisher is closed; it then returns nil. If PublisherConfig.Values was set and no state has been published yet, Run first sends the initial state.

#### func (Publisher) SetEnabled

```go
func (p *Publisher) SetEnabled(enabled bool) error
```

SetEnabled starts or stops transmission (GoEna). Re-enabling sends the current values as a new state with stNum 1: enabling GoEna restarts StNum at 1 (IEC 61850-7-2 18.2.3.6).

#### func (Publisher) SetFlags

```go
func (p *Publisher) SetFlags(test, simulation, ndsCom bool) error
```

SetFlags changes the test, simulation and needs-commissioning flags. The change is sent as a new state.

#### func (Publisher) State

```go
func (p *Publisher) State() PublisherState
```

State returns the current sequence state.

### type PublisherConfig

```go
type PublisherConfig struct {
	// Dst is the destination address (required). IEC 61850-8-1
	// recommends 01-0C-CD-01-00-00..01-0C-CD-01-01-FF.
	Dst MAC

	// Src is the source address. Zero uses the transport address.
	Src MAC

	// VLAN, when non-nil, adds an 802.1Q tag.
	VLAN *VLAN

	// AppID is the GOOSE APPID.
	AppID uint16

	// GocbRef is the GoCB reference (required), e.g.
	// "IED1LD0/LLN0$GO$gcb1".
	GocbRef string

	// DatSet is the dataset reference, e.g. "IED1LD0/LLN0$ds1".
	// Required unless NdsCom is set.
	DatSet string

	// GoID is the GOOSE identifier, at most [MaxGoIDLen] octets. Empty
	// uses GocbRef (not length-checked).
	GoID string

	// ConfRev is the configuration revision.
	ConfRev uint32

	// MinTime is the interval of the first retransmission after a
	// state change. Subsequent intervals double until MaxTime.
	// Zero uses [DefaultMinTime].
	MinTime time.Duration

	// MaxTime is the heartbeat interval in the steady state. Zero uses
	// [DefaultMaxTime].
	MaxTime time.Duration

	// TimeAllowedToLive is sent in every message. Zero uses 2*MaxTime.
	// It must be at least 1 ms and greater than MaxTime (8-1 18.1.2.5.1
	// Figure 10 key 2: the retransmission time is less than the
	// timeAllowedToLive).
	TimeAllowedToLive time.Duration

	// TimeQuality is the TimeQuality octet of T. Zero uses
	// [DefaultTimeQuality] (clock not synchronised); set it (for
	// example 0x0a) when the host clock is known to be synchronised.
	TimeQuality uint8

	// FixedOffs selects the fixed-length encoding of IEC 61850-8-1
	// Annex A.3 (SCL fixedOffs="true", see [EncodePDUFixedLength]).
	FixedOffs bool

	// MemberTypes are the MMS types of the dataset members, used by
	// FixedOffs for the integer and float widths. Optional.
	MemberTypes []mms.TypeSpec

	// Test sets the goosePdu test/simulation field.
	Test bool

	// Simulation sets the Reserved1 simulation bit.
	Simulation bool

	// NdsCom sets the needs-commissioning flag.
	NdsCom bool

	// InitialStNum is the state number of the first message. Zero
	// uses 1.
	InitialStNum uint32

	// Values are the initial dataset values. When set, [Publisher.Run]
	// sends them immediately and later calls to [Publisher.Publish]
	// must keep the same number and types of members.
	Values []*mms.Value

	// Logger receives publisher diagnostics. Nil disables logging.
	Logger *slog.Logger

	// Metrics receives counters. Nil disables metrics.
	Metrics Metrics

	// Now returns the current time; nil uses [time.Now]. It paces the
	// retransmissions and, without Clock, stamps T. Intended for tests.
	Now func() time.Time

	// Clock, when non-nil, stamps every new state: it returns T and
	// its TimeQuality octet, which then replaces TimeQuality.
	// Retransmission timing keeps using Now, so a step of Clock does
	// not change the retransmission curve. The server's GOOSE engine
	// sets it from ServerOptions.Clock.
	Clock func() (t time.Time, quality uint8)
}
```

PublisherConfig configures a [Publisher](#type-publisher).

### type PublisherState

```go
type PublisherState struct {
	StNum, SqNum uint32
	T            time.Time // time of the last state change
	Enabled      bool
	Interval     time.Duration // current retransmission interval
	Sent         uint64        // frames sent
}
```

PublisherState is a snapshot of a publisher's sequence state.

### type Status

```go
type Status int
```

Status is the supervision status of a GOOSE stream.

```go
const (
	// StatusWaiting means no message has been received yet.
	StatusWaiting Status = iota

	// StatusOK means valid messages are received within
	// TimeAllowedToLive.
	StatusOK

	// StatusTimeout means TimeAllowedToLive elapsed without a message.
	StatusTimeout

	// StatusInvalid means the last message failed validation (confRev,
	// datSet, goID or member layout).
	StatusInvalid

	// StatusNeedsCommissioning means the last message had ndsCom set.
	StatusNeedsCommissioning
)
```

```go
func (s Status) String() string
```

```go
type StreamKey struct {

}
```

StreamKey identifies one received GOOSE stream.

### type Subscriber

```go
type Subscriber struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Subscriber receives GOOSE frames from a transport and dispatches them to subscriptions.

#### func NewSubscriber

```go
func NewSubscriber(t Transport, cfg SubscriberConfig) (*Subscriber, error)
```

NewSubscriber returns a subscriber reading from t. Call [Subscriber.Run](#func-subscriber-run) to start receiving.

#### func (Subscriber) Close

```go
func (s *Subscriber) Close() error
```

Close closes all subscriptions. The transport is not closed; Run returns when the transport is closed or its context is cancelled.

#### func (Subscriber) HandleFrame

```go
func (s *Subscriber) HandleFrame(raw []byte)
```

HandleFrame decodes and dispatches one raw Ethernet frame. Run calls it for every received frame; it is exported for callers that own the receive loop.

#### func (Subscriber) HandleFrameFrom

```go
func (s *Subscriber) HandleFrameFrom(raw []byte, from netip.AddrPort)
```

HandleFrameFrom is [Subscriber.HandleFrame](#func-subscriber-handleframe) for a frame received from the network address from, which is reported as Frame.From. Run calls it when the transport is an [l2.SourceReceiver](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/l2#SourceReceiver).

#### func (Subscriber) Run

```go
func (s *Subscriber) Run(ctx context.Context) error
```

Run receives frames until ctx is done (returning nil), the subscriber is closed (returning nil) or the transport fails.

#### func (Subscriber) Subscribe

```go
func (s *Subscriber) Subscribe(cfg SubscriptionConfig) (*Subscription, error)
```

Subscribe adds a subscription.

### type SubscriberConfig

```go
type SubscriberConfig struct {
	// Limits bounds decoding (zero uses [DefaultLimits]).
	Limits Limits

	// Logger receives diagnostics. Nil disables logging.
	Logger *slog.Logger

	// Metrics receives counters. Nil disables metrics.
	Metrics Metrics

	// OnDecodeError, when non-nil, is called with frames that are not
	// valid GOOSE (non-GOOSE EtherTypes are ignored silently).
	OnDecodeError func(raw []byte, err error)

	// Now returns the current time; nil uses [time.Now].
	Now func() time.Time
}
```

SubscriberConfig configures a [Subscriber](#type-subscriber).

### type Subscription

```go
type Subscription struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Subscription is one set of filters with per-stream supervision.

#### func (Subscription) Close

```go
func (sub *Subscription) Close() error
```

Close removes the subscription, stops its timers and closes the event channel after pending events have been handed to the Handler.

#### func (Subscription) Events

```go
func (sub *Subscription) Events() <-chan Event
```

Events returns the event channel. It is closed by [Subscription.Close](#func-subscription-close). When a Handler is configured the channel is drained internally and must not be read.

#### func (Subscription) Supervision

```go
func (sub *Subscription) Supervision() []Supervision
```

Supervision returns a snapshot of every stream seen so far, ordered by gocbRef then source address.

### type SubscriptionConfig

```go
type SubscriptionConfig struct {
	// Dst filters on the destination address.
	Dst MAC

	// AppIDs filters on any of the listed APPIDs.
	AppIDs []uint16

	// GocbRef filters on the GoCB reference.
	GocbRef string

	// Src filters on the source address.
	Src MAC

	// DatSet, GoID and ConfRev are the expected values.
	DatSet  string
	GoID    string
	ConfRev uint32

	// Members, when non-nil, is the expected dataset layout: the
	// number of entries and the MMS type of each.
	Members []mms.TypeSpec

	// AcceptSimulation corresponds to LPHD.Sim: when false, frames with
	// the simulation bit are ignored; when true they are accepted and,
	// once one is seen on a stream, non-simulated frames of that
	// stream are ignored.
	AcceptSimulation bool

	// OnlyStateChanges delivers EventMessage only for new states;
	// retransmissions still feed supervision.
	OnlyStateChanges bool

	// Handler, when non-nil, is called for every event on a dedicated
	// goroutine, in order. Otherwise events are read from
	// [Subscription.Events].
	Handler func(Event)

	// QueueSize bounds the event queue (default 256). When full, events
	// are dropped and counted in Supervision.DroppedEvents.
	QueueSize int
}
```

SubscriptionConfig selects and validates GOOSE messages.

Filters with a zero value match everything; a subscription without any filter receives every GOOSE frame (monitor mode). Validation fields with a zero value are not checked.

### type Supervision

```go
type Supervision struct {
	Stream StreamKey
	Status Status

	// St is true while the subscription is valid (LGOS.St).
	St bool

	// SimSt is true when simulated messages are being accepted
	// (LGOS.SimSt).
	SimSt bool

	// NdsCom mirrors the last received ndsCom flag (LGOS.NdsCom).
	NdsCom bool

	// LastStNum and LastSqNum are the sequence numbers of the last
	// accepted message (LGOS.LastStNum).
	LastStNum, LastSqNum uint32

	// ConfRevNum is the expected configuration revision
	// (LGOS.ConfRevNum); RxConfRevNum is the last received one
	// (LGOS.RxConfRevNum).
	ConfRevNum, RxConfRevNum uint32

	// LastRx is the time of the last received message and
	// TimeAllowedToLive the TAL it carried.
	LastRx            time.Time
	TimeAllowedToLive time.Duration

	// LastErr is the last validation error, if any.
	LastErr error

	// Counters.
	Messages, StateChanges, Duplicates, OutOfOrder, StNumGaps, SqNumGaps,
	Restarts, Timeouts, Invalid, DroppedEvents uint64
}
```

Supervision is the supervision state of one stream, modelled on the LGOS logical node (IEC 61850-7-4).

### type Transport

```go
type Transport = l2.Transport
```

Transport sends and receives raw Ethernet frames; see [l2.Transport](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/l2#Transport).

#### func Open

```go
func Open(iface string, opts TransportOptions) (Transport, error)
```

Open opens a raw Ethernet transport on the named interface (Linux AF\_PACKET, macOS/BSD BPF; see [l2.Open](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/l2#Open)). When opts.EtherTypes is empty only GOOSE frames are received; add [l2.EtherTypeSV](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/l2#EtherTypeSV) and use an [l2.Demux](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/l2#Demux) to share the socket with an SV subscriber.

### type TransportError

```go
type TransportError = l2.TransportError
```

TransportError wraps an operating-system error from a raw Ethernet backend; see [l2.TransportError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/l2#TransportError).

### type TransportOptions

```go
type TransportOptions = l2.TransportOptions
```

TransportOptions configures [Open](#func-open); see [l2.TransportOptions](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/l2#TransportOptions).

### type VLAN

```go
type VLAN struct {
	// Priority is the 3-bit priority code point (0-7). IEC 61850-8-1
	// recommends 4 for GOOSE.
	Priority uint8

	// DEI is the drop eligible indicator. IEC 61850-8-1 Annex C
	// requires the bit (CFI) to be reset; it is settable only to build
	// negative test frames.
	DEI bool

	// ID is the 12-bit VLAN identifier (0-4095). 0 means priority
	// tagged only.
	ID uint16
}
```

VLAN is an IEEE 802.1Q tag.

### type ValidationError

```go
type ValidationError struct {

	Field   string
	Want    string

}
```

ValidationError describes a received message that failed subscriber validation. It unwraps to ErrValidation and to the specific sentinel in Err (ErrConfRevMismatch, ErrDatSetMismatch, ErrGoIDMismatch, ErrMemberMismatch or ErrNeedsCommissioning).
